description: This donut chart, titled “Stimulus Type,” visually represents the distribution of different stimulus categories, likely within a journalistic context, with each segment corresponding to a specific type and its percentage share. The chart is divided into eight distinct slices, each labeled with its category name and percentage. Starting from the top and moving clockwise, the largest segment is “Draft/Other (26.1%)” in a dark red color. Following this is “Press Release (18.7%)” in a yellowish-green, then “External News Article (18.1%)” in a dark green. Next is “Interview (8.8%)” in a dark blue, followed by “Organizational Report (7.7%)” in a purple, “Organizational Website (4.9%)” in a lighter purple, “Event Posting (6.6%)” in a reddish-brown, and finally “Social Media Post (1.1%)” in a light orange. The chart includes percentage labels directly on each slice, and the central white area contains the title “Stimulus Type.” The segments appear to be arranged in descending order of size, with the largest at the top.
